hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM curve for Uniswap v4 backed by Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it executes the full trade — depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults — and returns the token delta to the PoolManager via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, bypassing the standard concentrated-liquidity curve entirely.
